title: Personal Assistant to Director
description:
**Company Description**
Blusky Capital Management Private Limited is led by Siddharth, an industry veteran with over two decades of experience in Indian and global finance. His background spans senior roles at leading institutions including HDFC Bank, Standard Chartered Bank, Yes Bank, and Tata Sons, where he contributed to business excellence and strategic leadership. Siddharth brings deep expertise across investment strategies, P&L management, risk management, compliance, and process optimisation. He holds multiple advanced qualifications from prestigious international universities and professional bodies, reflecting a strong commitment to academic and professional excellence. The firm is built on core values of ethics, discipline, performance, and responsibility, offering a professional environment for individuals seeking to grow in the financial services domain.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Surat for a Personal Assistant to the Director. The Personal Assistant will manage the Director’s daily schedule, including diary management, meeting coordination, travel arrangements, and event planning. The role involves preparing and organizing documents, presentations, and reports, as well as handling correspondence and follow-ups with internal and external stakeholders. The Personal Assistant will support the Director with confidential administrative tasks, maintain records, and ensure timely completion of action items. The position requires proactive coordination, prioritization of tasks, and smooth day-to-day office functioning to enable the Director to focus on strategic responsibilities.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Personal Assistance and Executive Administrative Assistance skills to support senior leadership effectively.
* Candidates should possess solid Diary Management and scheduling skills to coordinate meetings, travel, and daily activities.
* Candidates should possess reliable Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills to manage documentation, correspondence, and office processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and the capacity to prioritize multiple tasks.
* Comfort with MS Office and common productivity tools; experience in financial services or corporate environments is an advantage.
* Relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree in business, administration, or a related field preferred.
